main_metric: Per document pair, average8aligned-quantile token-position Jaccards; activation z>0 native Top32; no amplitude in Jaccard.
pairing: Each dataset ordered by SHA256(S08+id). Within all unordered i<j: N(N-1)/2. Cross cyclic offsets1..(N-1)/2 moduloN: same N(N-1)/2 distinct pairs, each document degree(N-1)/2. N odd, no within self or duplicate unordered pair. All positions/repeated document incidences stay one cluster.
bootstrap: 1999 independent multinomial document-count resamples in each dataset, original pair graph reweighted by count_i*count_j, full document including all positions moves together. Weighted pair mean,95%percentile intervals; no independent token/pair bootstrap.
permutation: 999 whole-document label permutations plus-one p; fixed random-order pairing rule reapplied after relabeling, N unchanged. Main null requires exchangeability of entire document representations under labels, not randomized topic intervention. Length-matched permutes within full-token-length strata preserving both counts. Same-token control descriptive bootstrap only.
primary_tests: 2SAEs x3datasetpairs=6 one-sided pooled-within-minus-cross tests, Holm.05. A-minus-cross and B-minus-cross each reported with document CIs; claim both higher only if both lower bounds>0 and pooled Holm passes. Controls exploratory with raw p, no rescue. Interval spanning0 means inconclusive, not absence.
controls: Pair-specific matched full-token-length histograms, same question-only field rule and8sampling; fixed absolute31position (same32token visible prefix); preselected up to3 literal token IDs each occurring in>=20docs of each dataset, compare equal token at any of8sampled positions, document-pair mean, no conditional permutation p.
amplitude: Supplement only: at aligned positions compute RMS raw-z difference on intersection coordinates, average document pairs with shared-member coverage. Also whole-z L2 by dataset. Do not fold it into binary overlap.
